description: This file defines the AuthService class in a Java Spring backend project, responsible for user authentication functions such as registration, login, token refresh, and logout, using JWT tokens and interacting with repositories for user and token data.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Service class for handling user authentication operations including registration, login, token refresh, and logout.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user, assigns a default role, generates access and refresh tokens, and saves the refresh token.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user by email and password, then generates and returns new access and refresh tokens.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the access and refresh tokens after validating the provided refresh token.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Revokes the given refresh token to log the user out.

methods.name: saveRefreshToken
methods.description: Stores a hashed refresh token in the database associated with the user.

methods.name: sha256
methods.description: Computes the SHA-256 hash of a string, used for secure storage of token hashes.
